arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id, json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges
UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',e.event_id,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'kind',e.kind,'step',e.step) FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(request_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_event',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',json(payload),'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_booking',b.booking_id,json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending'

SELECT 'customer_event' AS kind,e.event_id AS id,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'kind',e.kind,'step',e.step) AS data FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(request_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',b.booking_id,json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'charge_state',c.state,'key',c.idempotency_key) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.client_reference IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'status',status,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE message LIKE '%bkg_28dd5f8fbf905f4a82ade4fc0b4b0dfa%' OR message LIKE '%bkg_d86f1b4d05e6598c8d954cdf4a9c8004%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',refund_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds
